h: Calls grow in Britain to stop Macklemore's Wembley 'Free Palestine' show
p: A group of British peers has reportedly asked the Home Secretary to block rapper Macklemore from entering the UK ahead of his concert at Wembley Arena on 30 October. The Jewish Leadership Council has also raised concerns with the promoter. Supporters say he is entitled to speak up for Palestinian rights.
more: He was dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour after on-stage comments last month.
Stars including Paloma Faith and Kehlani have backed him.
